From the equations \(a + bc = 34\) and \(b + ac = 29\), subtracting gives \((a - b)(1 - c) = 5\), or \((b - a)(c - 1) = 5\). Since \(a,b,c > 1\) are integers, \(c-1\) is a positive factor of 5: 1 or 5.

- If \(c-1=1 \Rightarrow c=2\), then \(b-a=5 \Rightarrow b=a+5\). Substituting into \(a+bc=34\): \(a+2(a+5)=3a+10=34 \Rightarrow a=8, b=13\). Total routes \(= c+ab = 2+104=106\).
- If \(c-1=5 \Rightarrow c=6\), then \(b-a=1 \Rightarrow b=a+1\). Substituting: \(a+6(a+1)=7a+6=34 \Rightarrow a=4, b=5\). Total routes \(= c+ab = 6+20=26\).

The minimum is 26.

\boxed{26}
